observationsNotFindings: The D9 prohibition is harder to satisfy here than anywhere else in this sweep, because DR-G28 exists precisely to test that a host does not mint a D9 class, exit or HostTermination. The join therefore has to discuss those tokens at length while producing none, and it does: every occurrence is a denial or a restatement of the gate's own claim, no token pattern of any form appears, and the only version reference points at the existing D9 v1.14 catalog. It also refuses more than asked, with 'Does not enumerate D9 tokens' alongside the invention denial - which closes the side channel by which a description could become a catalogue.

This is the second join in the family whose harness carries no namedCorpusNotAuthored field, and like the G26 join it cites liveHarnessCellVerbatim instead. The attack phrasing points at a field that does not exist on these harnesses, so a reviewer checking it mechanically gets null and could mistake that for a mismatch. Both joins are correct; the check has to follow the field the source actually uses.

Four joins in this sweep have now independently declined to import their own recording's required-now cardinalities - D-150's twenty, D-152's twenty-two, D-154's twenty-four here, and D-152's numbers again in the G14 chain. Against a live 26 those would each be false, and the consistency across independently authored artifacts suggests a settled convention rather than four separate strokes of care.

OBL-G28-FX-AUTHORING is the single open obligation and its corpus is one phrase over a two-class scope, the same narrow shape as G24 and G26. A later fixture cycle for this gate inherits a phrase, not a member roster - and here it must also author fixtures that prove a negative about D9 minting without minting anything.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: No blockers, no should-fix. The land test passes on the register: the live file 08 DR-G28 status cell reads OPEN and that is what the subject carries, with registerRowNote stating why DR-G28's own token belongs there rather than DR-131's standing. The hardest prohibition here is the D9 one, because DR-G28 exists precisely to test that a host does not mint a D9 class, exit or HostTermination - so the join must discuss those tokens at length while producing none. It does: all nine D9, five exit and five HostTermination occurrences are denials or restatements of the gate's own claim, no D9 token pattern of any form appears, the only version reference points at the existing v1.14 catalog, and the complete set of bare integers is 0, 1, 5, 26, the date 2026 and the 08 path segment. It also refuses more than asked, adding 'Does not enumerate D9 tokens' to the invention denial. As with the G26 join, the harness carries no namedCorpusNotAuthored field, so the attack's named check returns null; the subject correctly cites liveHarnessCellVerbatim instead, and its phrase is an exact suffix of that field which is byte-identical to the register cell. Scope matches live D-154 exactly - NT-7 and NT-8 fifteen occurrences each, NT-1 through NT-6 zero - and D-154's cardinalities of twenty-four and twenty-five are not imported against a live 26. No pin here is mine. 19 attacks run, 19 refuted.
